column1: # General Bots OS — expected appliance identity and boot markers (#2440).
# Tab-separated data file read by verify-image.sh. One key per line; repeat a
# key to list several values. Comments and blank lines are ignored.
# Keep this data deterministic: no timestamps, no absolute host paths, no
# build-specific values. This is the contract a mkosi image must satisfy before
# it may be published under the name generalbots-os.iso.
